cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: New Rule Required
cards.instruction: Use every problem as justification for adding another rule, ceremony, checkpoint, or layer of oversight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. You spilled one cup. From now on, drinks need pouring permits.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who issues those?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I'll appoint a pouring supervisor.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if the supervisor spills one?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. I'll add an appeals procedure before we serve anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was asking whether you'd pass the salt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request is under consideration.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get it myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent initiative. Approved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Welcome to my garage sale. Your offer to browse is accepted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's my garage. You're helping.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you're doing very well under my supervision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm going inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Granted. Take five.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You spilled one cup. From now on, drinks need pouring permits.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who issues those?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll appoint a pouring supervisor.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if the supervisor spills one?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. I'll add an appeals procedure before we serve anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The family photo failed because someone blinked. We need a blinking rota.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can't schedule a blink.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll rehearse unscheduled blinking before each photograph.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That will take all afternoon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We should appoint someone to monitor rehearsal duration.

cards.title: Lend Me the Edge
cards.instruction: Get someone to provide the one advantage you need without making the eventual success feel borrowed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Lend me your good tennis racket. I'd like my talent to have a fair surface.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you admit it helped?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I'll thank the strings. The strokes remain mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can use your own racket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And let inferior equipment take credit for my defeat?

beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.text: I was asking whether you'd pass the salt.

cards.title: Stay for the Result
cards.instruction: Keep them present until the contest, bargain, or consequence reaches an undeniable outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Don't leave the allotment until we've weighed both pumpkins.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yours is clearly bigger.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then you won't mind witnessing how much bigger.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tell me tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tomorrow you'll say the scales were generous. Stay for the number.

cards.title: Admit It Wasn’t Fair
cards.instruction: Get an apology that acknowledges how the rules, comparison, or outcome worked against you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before congratulating the winner, apologise for starting me behind the shed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You still finished last.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Yes. I spent the first ten seconds finding the race.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was an honest mistake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely opening. Add 'and that was unfair to you.'

cards.title: Call It a Fair Win
cards.instruction: Get them to recognize the result as deserved rather than accidental, gifted, or manipulated.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Say I earned the quiz trophy, not that the questions suited me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There were a lot of bird questions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I spent six months learning birds. That's preparation with feathers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You were lucky they asked them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And the birds were lucky I was ready. Now call it earned.
